request.style: English, female solo voice with soft choir, acoustic guitar, piano, strings, 80 BPM, gentle, hopeful
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Hunger and thirst for what is right
The empty soul finds light
Mercy flows to those who give
God’s grace will surely live
Pure in heart, they see the face
Of the loving, holy place

[Chorus]
Blessed are the peacemakers
They bridge the broken gaps and scars
For they will be called
Sons of God, by all

[Verse]
Persecuted for the truth they keep
Their reward in heaven’s sleep
Insults and lies may rain
But joy remains in every vein
Like prophets long ago
Their burden is not so

[Chorus]
Blessed are the peacemakers
They bridge the broken gaps and scars
For they will be called
Sons of God, by all

[Bridge]
Rejoice and be glad this day
Your reward is here to stay
Great in heaven, clear and bright
Shining through the darkest night

[Outro]
Blessed are the peacemakers
Called Sons of God, they are
